pages.text: At night, in the open, something drifts that has no will of its own: a cloud of particles taking an honest random walk. Near prey its steps lean toward it - a drift on top of the diffusion, the way a charged grain wanders in a field.
Its touch brings $(thing)Variance$(): luck evens out, and every good effect on you runs out twice as fast. Killed, it may leave a Normal Distribution Crystal: where it wandered, summed up.

And Maxwell's demon must forget what it sorted. Stand by a running $(item)Maxwell's Demon Sorter$() and its erasures spill into you: $(thing)Information Loss$() - the things you hold forget their places.
